title: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) vs Ondas Inc. (ONDS): Satellite Connectivity Ambitions Meet Defense Contract Momentum
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
* AST SpaceMobile focuses on building a space-based cellular broadband network, while Ondas Inc. specializes in private wireless networks, drones, and autonomous systems with growing defense applications.
* In recent market activity, [ASTS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ASTS/) has shown volatility tied to satellite launches, partnerships, and upcoming earnings, with mixed monthly performance.
* [ONDS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ONDS/) has recorded stronger recent momentum, including approximately 21% gains over the past month driven by multiple defense and military contracts.
* Both companies operate in technology and communications sectors but differ in risk profiles, with [ASTS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ASTS/) facing satellite deployment execution risks and [ONDS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ONDS/) benefiting from near-term contract wins.
* Market sentiment for [ASTS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ASTS/) reflects broader space economy interest, whereas [ONDS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ONDS/) sentiment has been supported by defense sector tailwinds.
* Relative positioning highlights trade-offs between long-term infrastructure plays and nearer-term revenue visibility from contracts.
